title: How useful is a 5090 if I already have a 3090?
body:
My use case is agentic coding. I'm a developer by trade and I like having a home lab for projects.

I currently have a 3090, 3080 10gb, a 265kf and 96fb of RAM. Long story short I got a 5090 because it was quite a bit below market price. I haven't received the 5090 yet, I'm still playing around with my 3090+3080 build.

I am using Qwen 3.8-27B and I'm as impressed as everyone else. My 3090 seems to run this model really well.

If I use this 5090 paired with a 3090, I'll be able to run 70B models. I'd also be able to run a much larger context window.

Will a 5090 really help me for coding tasks? Once I get my 5090+3090, should I expect to use 27B models + large context windows, or are there 70B models that are beating Qwen 3.8 27B?

Or, is this 5090 not really going to be helpful to me if I already have 34gb of VRAM?

submitted by /u/randylush
